/* ==========================================================================
   Spacing (Catalyst Design System 2.0.1). Rules: guide/rules.md §3
   Figma source: "5. Measurements" (size-ruler, gaps, paddings, margins, gutters, spacing/*).

   1. Scale  --space-*   ONE spacing scale for padding, gap and margin (100 = 4px). Same in every density.
             --size-*    Size ruler for dimensions only (heights, widths, icons, 1–3px optical nudges).
   2. Roles  change with density (Spacious / Comfortable / Compact):
             --space-inset    20 / 16 / 12  padding, on all four sides, of every container part:
                                            cards, panels, drawers, popovers
             --space-inset-l  24 / 20 / 16  modals and form cards (2.0.3)
             --space-table-x  20 / 16 / 16  table card edge and table cell sides (2.0.3)
             --space-stack    16 / 12 /  8  gap between blocks inside a container
             --space-section  40 / 32 / 24  gap between the sections of a page
   3. Page   --page-margin and --page-gap follow SCREEN WIDTH, not density: see foundations/layout.css.

   Which to use: a role for containers and the gaps between blocks

--space-50: 0.125rem
